page: Microsoft Azure NC8ads_A10_v4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCADSA10v4 server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor built on the x86_64 architecture. The virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 100.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.5 GB per vCPU.

For hardware acceleration, the server includes a single NVIDIA A10 GPU with 22 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 737 GB SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance.

Given the inclusion of a dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPU, a substantial 100.0 GB memory allocation, and local SSD storage, this server offers a resource-dense profile for specialized workloads. It is designed for GPU-accelerated applications, machine learning inference, video processing, and data-intensive workloads that benefit from local high-speed storage and dedicated compute resources.
